rfis.question: A2.01 Retail 124 note '*NOTE: GYPSUM BOARD & FINISH IN RETAIL SPACE BY FUTURE TENANT': are the retail-side faces of the perimeter walls in our bid?
rfis.loaded: retail-side faces INCLUDED (conservative)

resolved.answer: Printed (option A): A2.01 '*NOTE: GYPSUM BOARD & FINISH IN RETAIL SPACE BY FUTURE TENANT' - NON-rated retail faces EXCLUDED (532.5 SF: W.6-L1-23 A, FI.2-L1-09, FI.2-L1-10, XW.6.4-L1-03); retail faces of RATED assemblies (tag rating > 0: XW.6.2-2, XW.6.3-2, XW.6.4-2, 1,033 SF) stay loaded because the printed rating requires the layer. Delta if the tenant also builds the rated layers: -1,033 SF. Sweep of every -0 wall facing Retail 124 (1/A2.01): XW.6.4-L1-04 (1.00 ft) excluded; XW.6.3-L1-01 split at the end of vestibule 108.1 (2.02 ft kept, 3.56 ft retail part excluded); FI.2-L1-06 split at x 1017.2 pt (7.23 ft kept E of door 121.1, 32.80 ft retail / ELEC 120 tenant part excluded). Ceilings, same criterion: the GYP-1 11'-0" band S of the storefront (A3.01 / 1/A7.31) is inside Retail 124 = by tenant (delta +346.4 SF if ours); the FS-1 rated membrane over Retail 124 (2,373 SF printed) and Kitchen 100 (682.7 SF, flood of 1/A2.01) stays loaded because the printed 1 HR floor assembly requires it (delta -3,055.7 SF Type C + RC if the tenant builds it)

rfis.question: FW.4-L4-19 (Level 4, Deck Bar 411 / corridor 412): the tag on 1/A2.04 prints 'FW.4 | 1' and 2/A0.02 shows the bar walls as 1HR FP and A8.00 rates door 411.1 CONVERTIBLE DECK BAR '20 MIN' (the 1 HR fire partition door of IBC Table 716.1(2)): the 1 HR is printed; but A0.06 prints the FW family only with rating '--' (no FW.4-1 row). CODE: IBC 2018 §708 fire partitions (https://codes.iccsafe.org/content/IBC2018P6/chapter-7-fire-and-smoke-protection-features; verified in ICC 2026-11-06, _PUENTE_CLAUDE COD-001). What is the 1-HR assembly of this wall?
rfis.loaded: BASE (larger option while the RFI is open): 1 HR - 1 layer 5/8" Type X added on the bar face; both faces to the underside of the roof sheathing (2/A0.10)

resolved.answer: Printed + code (U-155): the 1 HR is printed (tag 'FW.4 | 1' on 1/A2.04, 2/A0.02 '1HR FP', A8.00 door 411.1 '20 MIN' = the 1 HR fire partition door of IBC 2018 Table 716.1(2)); the assembly is the 1 HR wood-stud fire partition of IBC 2018 Section 708 with 1 layer 5/8" Type X each face (IBC 2018 Table 721.1(2) wood stud wall, 5/8" Type X each side = 1 HR) - as loaded, delta 0

The take-off height was 12'-0" B.O. DECK (5/A5.04). CODE: IBC 2018 Section 707.5 - fire barriers extend from the floor to the underside of the floor or roof sheathing above. To what height does the board of the L1 fire barriers run?
rfis.loaded: LOADED (conservative, IBC 2018 Section 707.5): 13'-9 1/2" to the underside of the L2 floor sheathing (14'-0" - 1 1/2" topping - 1/4" mat - 3/4" sheathing, S1.02)

resolved.answer: Resolved by code, IBC 2018 Section 707.5 (U-155, user 8-nov: search the set; if not printed, apply the IBC and cite it): no head detail of the L1 2 HR fire barriers against the L2 floor is printed (A0.06 wood head 'line of structure' without dimension; 2/A0.10 covers the roof only); IBC 2018 Section 707.5 'Fire barriers shall extend from the top of the foundation or floor/ceiling assembly below to the underside of the floor or roof sheathing, slab or deck above' (continuous through concealed spaces) -> loaded to the underside of the L2 floor sheathing, 14'-0" - 1 1/2" topping - 1/4" mat - 3/4" sheathing (S1.02) = 13'-9 1/2"; the bottom of the L2 floor trusses here is 14'-0" - 2 1/2" - 18" (S1.03 FT-1) = 11'-11 1/2" [DERIVED] and 707.5 runs the barrier past it to the sheathing (the 12'-0" B.O. DECK printed on 5/A5.04 is the metal deck of grids H-K, not over this block); no deduct alternate
